<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<title>Brick Breaker</title>
<style>
  html, body { margin: 0; height: 100%; background: #111; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
  canvas { background: #1b1d2a; display: block; max-width: 100vw; max-height: 100vh; cursor: none; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game" width="800" height="600"></canvas>
<script>
(() => {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const W = canvas.width, H = canvas.height;
  const BAR_H = 40;
  const SAVE_KEY = 'brickBreaker.progress';
  const BEST_KEY = 'brickBreaker.best';

  // Brick layouts: '#' = normal brick, '2' = two-hit brick, '.' = empty
  const LEVELS = [
    [
      '##########',
      '##########',
      '##########',
      '##########',
    ],
    [
      '#........#',
      '##......##',
      '###....###',
      '####..####',
      '##########',
    ],
    [
      '....##....',
      '...####...',
      '..######..',
      '.########.',
      '..######..',
      '...####...',
      '....##....',
    ],
    [
      '#.#.#.#.#.',
      '.#.#.#.#.#',
      '#.#.#.#.#.',
      '.#.#.#.#.#',
      '2222222222',
    ],
    [
      '2222222222',
      '2........2',
      '2.######.2',
      '2.#2222#.2',
      '2.######.2',
      '2........2',
      '2222222222',
    ],
  ];
  const COLORS = ['#ff5c5c', '#ffa94d', '#ffd43b', '#69db7c', '#4dabf7', '#9775fa', '#f783ac'];

  const COLS = 10, BRICK_GAP = 4, BRICK_TOP = BAR_H + 40, BRICK_H = 22, SIDE = 20;
  const BRICK_W = (W - SIDE * 2 - BRICK_GAP * (COLS - 1)) / COLS;

  const paddle = { w: 110, h: 14, x: W / 2 - 55, y: H - 40, speed: 520 };
  const ball = { x: 0, y: 0, r: 8, vx: 0, vy: 0 };

  let bricks = [];
  let level = 1, score = 0, lives = 3, best = 0;
  let state = 'serve'; // serve | play | gameover | win
  let paused = false;
  const keys = { left: false, right: false };
  let mouseX = null;

  function loadBest() {
    const b = parseInt(localStorage.getItem(BEST_KEY), 10);
    best = isNaN(b) ? 0 : b;
  }
  function saveBest() {
    if (score > best) { best = score; localStorage.setItem(BEST_KEY, String(best)); }
  }
  function saveProgress() {
    localStorage.setItem(SAVE_KEY, JSON.stringify({ level, score, lives }));
  }
  function loadProgress() {
    try {
      const p = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(SAVE_KEY));
      if (p && p.level >= 1 && p.level <= LEVELS.length) {
        level = p.level;
        score = Math.max(0, p.score | 0);
        lives = p.lives >= 1 && p.lives <= 3 ? p.lives : 3;
        return;
      }
    } catch (e) {}
    level = 1; score = 0; lives = 3;
  }

  function buildLevel(n) {
    bricks = [];
    LEVELS[n - 1].forEach((row, r) => {
      for (let c = 0; c < COLS; c++) {
        const ch = row[c];
        if (ch === '#' || ch === '2') {
          bricks.push({
            x: SIDE + c * (BRICK_W + BRICK_GAP),
            y: BRICK_TOP + r * (BRICK_H + BRICK_GAP),
            w: BRICK_W, h: BRICK_H,
            hits: ch === '2' ? 2 : 1,
            color: COLORS[r % COLORS.length],
          });
        }
      }
    });
  }

  function resetBall() {
    state = 'serve';
    ball.vx = 0; ball.vy = 0;
    placeBallOnPaddle();
  }
  function placeBallOnPaddle() {
    ball.x = paddle.x + paddle.w / 2;
    ball.y = paddle.y - ball.r - 1;
  }

  function startLevel(n) {
    level = n;
    buildLevel(level);
    paddle.x = W / 2 - paddle.w / 2;
    resetBall();
    saveProgress();
  }

  function newGame() {
    score = 0; lives = 3; paused = false;
    startLevel(1);
  }

  function nextLevel() {
    if (level >= LEVELS.length) {
      state = 'win';
      saveBest();
      localStorage.removeItem(SAVE_KEY);
    } else {
      startLevel(level + 1);
    }
  }

  function launch() {
    if (paused) return;
    if (state === 'serve') {
      const speed = 380 + (level - 1) * 30;
      const angle = (-Math.PI / 2) + (Math.random() * 0.6 - 0.3);
      ball.vx = Math.cos(angle) * speed;
      ball.vy = Math.sin(angle) * speed;
      state = 'play';
    } else if (state === 'gameover' || state === 'win') {
      newGame();
    }
  }

  function loseLife() {
    lives--;
    if (lives <= 0) {
      lives = 0;
      state = 'gameover';
      saveBest();
      localStorage.removeItem(SAVE_KEY);
    } else {
      saveProgress();
      resetBall();
    }
  }

  // Input
  window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    const k = e.key;
    if (k === 'ArrowLeft') { keys.left = true; e.preventDefault(); }
    else if (k === 'ArrowRight') { keys.right = true; e.preventDefault(); }
    else if (k === ' ' || k === 'Spacebar') { e.preventDefault(); launch(); }
    else if (k === 'p' || k === 'P') {
      if (state === 'serve' || state === 'play') paused = !paused;
    } else if (k === 'n' || k === 'N') {
      if (state === 'serve' || state === 'play') { paused = false; nextLevel(); }
    }
  });
  window.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
    if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') keys.left = false;
    else if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') keys.right = false;
  });
  canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    mouseX = (e.clientX - rect.left) * (W / rect.width);
  });
  canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => { e.preventDefault(); launch(); });

  // Update
  function update(dt) {
    if (paused || state === 'gameover' || state === 'win') return;

    // Paddle
    if (keys.left || keys.right) {
      mouseX = null;
      paddle.x += ((keys.right ? 1 : 0) - (keys.left ? 1 : 0)) * paddle.speed * dt;
    } else if (mouseX !== null) {
      paddle.x = mouseX - paddle.w / 2;
    }
    paddle.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(W - paddle.w, paddle.x));

    if (state === 'serve') { placeBallOnPaddle(); return; }

    // Ball, substepped to avoid tunneling
    const steps = Math.ceil(Math.hypot(ball.vx, ball.vy) * dt / 4);
    const sdt = dt / steps;
    for (let i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
      ball.x += ball.vx * sdt;
      ball.y += ball.vy * sdt;

      // Walls
      if (ball.x - ball.r < 0) { ball.x = ball.r; ball.vx = Math.abs(ball.vx); }
      if (ball.x + ball.r > W) { ball.x = W - ball.r; ball.vx = -Math.abs(ball.vx); }
      if (ball.y - ball.r < BAR_H) { ball.y = BAR_H + ball.r; ball.vy = Math.abs(ball.vy); }

      // Paddle
      if (ball.vy > 0 &&
          ball.y + ball.r >= paddle.y && ball.y - ball.r <= paddle.y + paddle.h &&
          ball.x >= paddle.x - ball.r && ball.x <= paddle.x + paddle.w + ball.r) {
        const speed = Math.hypot(ball.vx, ball.vy);
        const hit = ((ball.x - (paddle.x + paddle.w / 2)) / (paddle.w / 2));
        const angle = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, hit)) * (Math.PI / 3);
        ball.vx = Math.sin(angle) * speed;
        ball.vy = -Math.cos(angle) * speed;
        ball.y = paddle.y - ball.r;
      }

      // Bricks
      for (let j = 0; j < bricks.length; j++) {
        const b = bricks[j];
        const cx = Math.max(b.x, Math.min(ball.x, b.x + b.w));
        const cy = Math.max(b.y, Math.min(ball.y, b.y + b.h));
        const dx = ball.x - cx, dy = ball.y - cy;
        if (dx * dx + dy * dy <= ball.r * ball.r) {
          const overlapX = Math.min(ball.x + ball.r - b.x, b.x + b.w - (ball.x - ball.r));
          const overlapY = Math.min(ball.y + ball.r - b.y, b.y + b.h - (ball.y - ball.r));
          if (overlapX < overlapY) {
            ball.vx = ball.x < b.x + b.w / 2 ? -Math.abs(ball.vx) : Math.abs(ball.vx);
          } else {
            ball.vy = ball.y < b.y + b.h / 2 ? -Math.abs(ball.vy) : Math.abs(ball.vy);
          }
          b.hits--;
          if (b.hits <= 0) {
            bricks.splice(j, 1);
            score += 10 * level;
          } else {
            score += 5;
          }
          saveBest();
          break;
        }
      }

      if (bricks.length === 0) { nextLevel(); return; }

      if (ball.y - ball.r > H) { loseLife(); return; }
    }
  }

  // Render
  function drawCenterText(lines) {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, BAR_H, W, H - BAR_H);
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    lines.forEach((l, i) => {
      ctx.fillStyle = i === 0 ? '#fff' : '#bbb';
      ctx.font = i === 0 ? 'bold 56px sans-serif' : '20px sans-serif';
      ctx.fillText(l, W / 2, H / 2 + (i === 0 ? -20 : 20 + i * 28));
    });
  }

  function render() {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // Status bar
    ctx.fillStyle = '#0d0e16';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, BAR_H);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 18px sans-serif';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 16, BAR_H / 2);
    ctx.fillText('Lives: ' + lives, 230, BAR_H / 2);
    ctx.fillText('Level: ' + level, 420, BAR_H / 2);
    ctx.fillText('Best: ' + Math.max(best, score), 610, BAR_H / 2);

    // Bricks
    for (const b of bricks) {
      ctx.fillStyle = b.color;
      ctx.fillRect(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h);
      if (b.hits > 1) {
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff';
        ctx.lineWidth = 3;
        ctx.strokeRect(b.x + 1.5, b.y + 1.5, b.w - 3, b.h - 3);
      }
    }

    // Paddle
    ctx.fillStyle = '#e9ecef';
    ctx.fillRect(paddle.x, paddle.y, paddle.w, paddle.h);

    // Ball
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, ball.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.fill();

    if (state === 'serve' && !paused) {
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ccc';
      ctx.font = '18px sans-serif';
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.fillText('Press Space or click to launch', W / 2, H / 2 + 60);
    }

    if (state === 'gameover') drawCenterText(['Game over', 'Press Space or click to play again']);
    else if (state === 'win') drawCenterText(['You win', 'Press Space or click to play again']);
    else if (paused) drawCenterText(['Paused', 'Press P to resume']);
  }

  let last = performance.now();
  function loop(now) {
    const dt = Math.min(0.033, (now - last) / 1000);
    last = now;
    update(dt);
    render();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  loadBest();
  loadProgress();
  buildLevel(level);
  resetBall();
  saveProgress();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

    const dt = Math.min(0.033, (now - last) / 1000);
    last = now;
    update(dt);
    render();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  loadBest();
  loadProgress();
  buildLevel(level);
  resetBall();
  saveProgress();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
